description:
Every public plan-producing entry point in the repository-materialization module returns a typed error, replacing the `Producer(String)` stringify-then-downcast round-trip with typed variants that reach exit-code mapping through an exhaustive match.

## Background

Producer failures currently stringify through `RepositoryStateError::Producer(String)` (34 sites; sink at `repository_state/mod.rs:583` via `format!("{error:#}")`) and are re-typed by a runtime downcast chain `projection_producer` (`mod.rs:590-598`); the exit-code boundary (`main.rs:104,783`) probes with `downcast_ref` + `is_profile_target_conflict`. Exit-code correctness therefore depends on a downcast that silently degrades when a new producer error type appears. This task retypes the whole `crates/jit/src/repository_state/` module.

1. New `ProducerError` (thiserror), each variant carrying its typed source: `MissingCapture(&'static str)`, `MalformedUtf8(#[from] FromUtf8Error)`, `UnknownProjection(String)`, `UnknownKind { projection, kind }`, plus transparent `#[from]` for `CaptureError`, `RepositoryLayoutError`, `ConfigurationDeclarationError`, `InvariantConfigError`, `ItemError`, `RuleConfigError`, `ProjectionError`, `ManagedDocumentError`. The six `materialize.rs` producers (`read_text`, `assemble_config`, `assemble_config_from_declarations`, `render_capture_closure`, `validate_capture_closure`, `compose_configured_projections`) and the two internal `anyhow` leaves - `render_projection_body` (`projection_render.rs:62`, whose injected read-closure becomes `FnMut(&str) -> Result<Option<String>, ProducerError>`) and `validate_proposed_layout` (`artifact_classifier.rs:515`) - return `Result<_, ProducerError>`.
2. `RepositoryStateError::Producer(String)` becomes `Producer(#[from] ProducerError)`. `fn producer`, `fn projection_producer`, `fn is_profile_target_conflict`, and the twelve `.map_err(...producer...)` sites (`mod.rs:405,415,428,431,436,520,612,617,645,648,678,683`) are deleted in favor of `?`. The inline `Producer(format!)` sites (`mod.rs:501,508`) become `ProducerError::ConfigParse` and a new `RepositoryStateError::Overlay(#[from] OverlayError)`. The profile-application producer (`profile_apply.rs`, `Producer(String)`/`producer` sites at `:397,:435,:469,:678` plus the `profile_registry_error` helper) retypes with profile-specific variants - `ProfileRegistryNotFile { target }`, `ProfileRegistryParse { target, #[source] source }`, `ProfileContributionConflict { identity, registry }`; `compose_default_ruleset` stays as is.
3. `finalize_gate_registry_edit` returns `Result<_, RepositoryStateError>` via a new `GateRegistryEditError { MissingEdit, MultipleEdits, DeclarationMismatch }` variant, with `#[from]` variants for its eight `?`-propagated leaf classes (`MutationError`, `GateDeclarationError`, `OverlayError`, `SeedError` join the existing `Delta`/`PlanHash`/`Layout`).
4. `finalize_archive_execution` returns `Result<_, RepositoryStateError>` via a new `ArchiveExecutionError` enumerating the archive-specific classes at their construction sites - `MissingDestination`, `MissingContentIdentity`, `ContentIdentityChanged`, `NonFileSource{role}`, `UnsafeOccupant{role}`, `MissingPlannedDocument`, `RelinkTargetsPinned`, `RelinkStale`, `MissingCapturedIssue`, `MalformedIssueJson(#[source] serde_json::Error)`, `IssueIdMismatch`, `CapturedIssueCacheLost`, `MissingChangedIssue` - plus `#[from]` for its typed leaves (`EventLogError`, `PlanError`, the retyped `validate_proposed_layout`).
5. `main.rs::error_to_exit_code` replaces the two downcast probes with one exhaustive match over `RepositoryStateError` (no `_ =>` arm): projection/managed-document/profile-conflict/ambiguous-ownership/gate-registry-edit/archive-execution variants map to the validation-failed exit; capture/parse producer variants to the generic exit; layout variants to the invalid-argument exit. The profile `--json` boundary keeps its single sanctioned `downcast_ref::<RepositoryStateError>` on the anyhow CLI transport, but `profile_json_error` (`main.rs:770-791`) matches the `ProfileTargetConflict` variant instead of the deleted `is_profile_target_conflict` bool (new profile producer variants map to `PROFILE_CONFLICT`/`PROFILE_ERROR` codes explicitly).

Acceptance is module-wide, not per enumerated site: (a) no function in `crates/jit/src/repository_state/` carries an `anyhow` type in its signature; (b) no error value is constructed with `format!`, and `String`-typed variant fields carry raw identifiers (a projection name, a registry target) captured by value, never a pre-rendered message - all rendering lives in `Display` impls.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `ProducerError` exists with the variants above; `RepositoryStateError::Producer` carries `#[from] ProducerError`; `fn producer`, `fn projection_producer`, and `fn is_profile_target_conflict` are deleted and their former callers use `?`.
- [hard] REQ-02: `finalize_gate_registry_edit` and `finalize_archive_execution` return typed `RepositoryStateError` values via the new `GateRegistryEditError` and `ArchiveExecutionError` types.
- [hard] REQ-03: No function in `crates/jit/src/repository_state/` carries an `anyhow` type in its signature.
- [hard] REQ-04: No error value in `crates/jit/src/repository_state/` is constructed with `format!`; `String`-typed error-variant fields hold raw identifiers, and all message rendering lives in `Display` impls.
- [hard] REQ-05: `main.rs::error_to_exit_code` maps producer failures through an exhaustive match over `RepositoryStateError` with no fallback (`_ =>`) arm.
- [hard] REQ-06: Existing behavior and exit codes are preserved; the failure-path tests pass unchanged.

## Notes

Scope is the whole `repository_state` module: beyond the enumerated surfaces, retire every remaining `anyhow` signature and `format!`-constructed error value in `crates/jit/src/repository_state/`, including the export, initialization, and profile-application paths, because criteria (a)/(b) are checked module-wide. The exhaustive `main.rs` match owned here must also carry an arm for the command layer's mutation-session terminal error (contributed by the retry-contract work) so it stays exhaustive; the finalizer signature changes compose through the command modules' unchanged anyhow boundary.
title: Typed producer and finalizer errors for the repository-state module
